source_conversation.content: My wife sent me a Family Sharing invite by text. I'm on my iPhone. How do I accept it?

sections.text: On iPhone: You'll get an invitation to join a Family Sharing group by email or in a text message. You can respond directly from that invitation. Open Settings, tap your name, then tap Invitations. To accept, complete the onscreen instructions. You may be asked to confirm your Apple Account information and opt in to any features or services that your Family Sharing group has set up. You can be a part of only one Family Sharing group at a time. If you can't accept the invitation, check if someone else joined a Family Sharing group with your Apple Account.
